name: @memberjunction/video-studio-render-worker
description: Isolated HyperFrames and headless Chromium render worker for MemberJunction Video Studio

scripts.browser:install: node --input-type=module -e "import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; const req = createRequire(import.meta.resolve('@hyperframes/engine')); process.argv = ['node', 'puppeteer', 'browsers', 'install', 'chrome-headless-shell']; await import(pathToFileURL(req.resolve('puppeteer/lib/puppeteer/node/cli.js')).href);"

author: MemberJunction.com
